name: CyberSecEval 2
description: CyberSecEval 2 is a comprehensive cybersecurity evaluation suite for large language models, introducing tests for prompt injection, code interpreter abuse, and a novel metric for safety-utility tradeoff called False Refusal Rate (FRR). It also includes test sets for evaluating LLMs' capabilities in automating software vulnerability exploitation.
reputation: Widely cited as a leading cybersecurity benchmark suite for LLM safety and misuse evaluation, especially for prompt injection and false-refusal tradeoff analysis.
notes: Focuses on security risks of LLMs including prompt injection and code interpreter abuse; introduces safety-utility tradeoff metric FRR; evaluates multiple SOTA LLMs.
